cuts.item: middle school sports and student-athlete transportation, reinstated

statements.statement: School department warrant article requests an additional $418,056 to be raised and appropriated for the FY27 school operating budget.
Board voted unanimously to include the school department's $418,056 FY27 article on the special town meeting warrant.
Citizens' petition article to raise and appropriate, or transfer from available funds, a sum of money to supplement the school department's FY2027 operating budget; no sum stated.

Citizens' petition article to transfer $151,338.38 from certified free cash or available funds to the schools' FY2027 operating budget to reinstate middle school sports and provide student-athlete transportation.
Board voted unanimously to approve the full special town meeting warrant with all three FY27 school budget articles in the order presented.

Town manager stated there is currently no certified free cash available; free cash isn't certified until after June 30 and the books close, so this early in the fiscal year none exists to fund the school supplement.
Town manager stated it is very unlikely, nearly impossible, that certified free cash will exist by the September 3rd special town meeting.
